content.question: Choose a bounded first-use experience for a hypothetical offline video-analysis tool. Compare a bundled synthetic example with contextual help.
content.desired_output: A practical recommendation, alternatives and trade-offs, explicit supporting contribution/source IDs, responses to material challenges, unresolved concerns and evidence limits. Discuss only; no implementation.
content.constraints: Hypothetical evidence only; one engineer-week; keyboard-only access; no network or personal-video requirement. Recommend an option with trade-offs and unresolved evidence/accessibility questions. Discuss only. No research, implementation, external actions or assignments.
content.recommendation: Discussion-only recommendation: offer an optional bundled synthetic example as the bounded first-use path, alongside concise contextual guidance and an equally visible Start empty choice. The ceiling is one non-autoplay clip opened through the ordinary offline flow, one plainly explained analysis result, and a keyboard-reachable exit/return. This is conditional, not an owner decision or build approval.
content.alternatives: Contextual help alone is likely lower-cost and less cluttered, and avoids implying synthetic output generalizes; however, it may leave a blank workspace and postpone value until a user supplies video. A sample plus elaborate interactive tour could offer more instruction but risks exceeding one engineer-week and introducing keyboard/accessibility complexity; do not prefer it within this bound. If the bounded sample fails the stated feasibility or accessibility thresholds, prefer contextual help alone.
content.supporting_findings: The charter requires hypothetical-only discussion, one engineer-week, keyboard-only access, and no network or personal-video requirement (cmessage_5a30a21b-2466-4eae-9269-5ad90e8411c4). Owner-supplied hypothetical material says a sample may show immediate value, help may cost less but leave an empty workspace, and there are no interviews, metrics, or accessibility tests (evidence_045548ea-b998-4829-a2ce-e5584d3061c0). Grace initially favored a small labeled sample plus short guidance and identified licensing/size and ordinary-flow assumptions (cmessage_1eb14370-4429-4a66-a013-f010f44eead2). Maya specified the optional bounded interaction (cmessage_734175f8-f2f4-4191-87b7-20706be3e4c1; cmessage_5bd7928e-d027-47b4-8d1e-4ac273c43d4b). Grace accepted that ceiling conditionally, not as a feasibility claim (cmessage_3b8f4d3e-1d17-4090-88f7-2a152b38cee0).
content.challenges_addressed: Grace asked for the minimum sample that demonstrates value under one engineer-week and remains keyboard-operable (cmessage_1eb14370-4429-4a66-a013-f010f44eead2). Maya answered with optional Open example/Start empty, one non-autoplay sample in the normal flow, one legible result, and keyboard-reachable return (cmessage_5bd7928e-d027-47b4-8d1e-4ac273c43d4b). Grace's review sharpened the fallback: use help-only if a sample needs bespoke tour or substantial media/result plumbing, focus order/result announcement/controls/exit cannot reliably work by keyboard, or staged output would misrepresent normal analysis (cmessage_3b8f4d3e-1d17-4090-88f7-2a152b38cee0). Maya incorporated these conditions (cmessage_e22dbf0c-293e-45f7-b482-aa4d36dd79b9).
content.dissent_and_risks: No continuing disagreement is recorded: Grace supports the conditional sample plus concise help, while emphasizing that an inaccessible or misleading sample is worse than accessible help. Risks include package size/licensing, feasibility within one engineer-week, keyboard focus and control behavior, perceivable result, clean exit, and misleading synthetic-to-real transfer. Do not treat conditional convergence as tested accessibility or owner approval.
content.missing_evidence_and_confidence: Low confidence in comparative user benefit and feasibility: the only source is owner-supplied hypothetical material, not independently verified; no interviews, usage metrics, engineering estimate, accessibility test, or demonstration that the synthetic result reflects normal real-video analysis. It remains unknown whether users understand the result, whether sample content is representative, and whether the whole path works keyboard-only. The source's supplied timestamp is not an observation time for user behavior.
content.next_actions_and_approvals: No research, implementation, external action, or assignment is proposed here. An owner would need to separately decide whether to adopt the conditional recommendation and authorize any later validation or implementation. If considering that decision, unresolved questions are whether the bounded sample fits the one-engineer-week constraint, is packageable without network/personal video, is representative, and is reliably keyboard-accessible; otherwise select contextual help alone.

content.question: Use public software onboarding/documentation patterns to recommend a practical first-use approach for a small offline-capable tool. Compare evidence and trade-offs.
content.desired_output: A practical recommendation, alternatives and trade-offs, explicit supporting contribution/source IDs, responses to material challenges, unresolved concerns and evidence limits. Discuss only; no implementation.
content.constraints: Atlas: choose an appropriate team from existing eligible workers. Only Atlas has an explicit public research grant. Investigate a material public question using your own bounded search queries; retrieve and share relevant evidence from at least two distinct public sources with the managed reader when available. Distinguish retrieved page content from search snippets. Other participants should inspect the shared exports and evaluate their relevance and limits. Discuss specific earlier contributions when clarification is worthwhile. Hypothetical product, one engineer-week, privacy and accessibility constraints. No implementation, publication, hiring or implied approvals.
content.recommendation: Proposed, not approved: use an example-first first screen, conditional on a clean-install offline feasibility gate. Offer a clearly labeled, redistributable non-personal sample clip, one explicit local-analysis action, a concise text explanation of the result and sample limits, plus an equally visible choose-local-file route. Do not claim this already works. If the sample or dependencies cannot produce a meaningful offline result, lead instead with a short, honest prerequisite/availability checklist before offering the action.
content.supporting_findings: Owner brief evidence_e7fab80f-b4a4-4fd7-8e6e-f423299eed8c establishes only a local video-analysis prototype, no analytics, and a useful first action without uploading personal media. Maya cmessage_7f595673-971a-4dba-a4cb-f6af0844b8c8, Turing cmessage_423b6a55-c6b5-4af2-8ee3-cf58b0ccb9d3, Scout cmessage_294d9985-ff35-4156-9881-d681e3fce579, and Grace cmessage_00e5c944-c295-4799-a81d-f4f88413bc30 converge conditionally on example-first. Public retrieved-page excerpt evidence_f62cc5c8-8b87-4cb4-bcd2-309e390ab2d5 documents GIMP's contextual F1 help, supporting contextual help as an available software pattern, not its efficacy here. Public retrieved-page excerpt evidence_c2e0e5cd-e80d-4eb6-9fc7-af77c569a26d states WCAG's on-input caution against unannounced context changes; it supports predictable first-use controls, not certification of this design. Both page excerpts were retrieved 2026-10-01; publication and observation times are unknown; excerpts are very short relative to source pages.
content.alternatives: A multi-screen guided setup may be needed for unavoidable dependencies, but delays first value and adds state, focus, copy and error handling within one engineer-week. Contextual help beside controls/results is a useful supplement, but alone does not surface the first action. A bare sample is low-friction but risks overstating real-media performance and obscuring provenance; label it and explain its limits. A checklist-first path is the fallback if clean offline sample execution fails, not the default if it works.
content.challenges_addressed: Turing's cmessage_423b6a55-c6b5-4af2-8ee3-cf58b0ccb9d3 challenges the assumed license/dependency/runtime readiness: retain the example only after clean-install offline verification, otherwise use the checklist. Scout's cmessage_294d9985-ff35-4156-9881-d681e3fce579 challenges source relevance: the two public excerpts support only contextual-help and predictable-control principles, not evidence that an immediate sample action improves outcomes. Grace's cmessage_00e5c944-c295-4799-a81d-f4f88413bc30 challenges video-only success: require keyboard-operable controls and text-interpretable results, with clear waiting/error states, as review criteria rather than established capabilities. Maya's cmessage_7f595673-971a-4dba-a4cb-f6af0844b8c8 flags privacy wording: describe only verified processing and retention, not inferred zero upload/retention.
content.dissent_and_risks: No substantive dissent is recorded; convergence is conditional. Atlas organized the team in cmessage_a7e74f09-ad91-4a8b-a2fc-f7ff50e60c25, but Atlas's opening/research turn was blocked, so Atlas did not evaluate the exported sources or answer targeted questions. No dedicated accessibility specialist participated. Public documentation excerpts do not prove product-specific effectiveness or accessibility. Sample selection could flatter performance; inaccurate privacy wording could mislead; unavailable offline dependencies could break first use.
content.missing_evidence_and_confidence: Moderate confidence in the conditional design logic, low confidence in actual feasibility or outcomes. Unanswered: license-cleared sample availability, size, model/dependency packaging, clean-install offline runtime, meaningful text interpretation, verified data flow/retention, and whether a prerequisite is unavoidable. No telemetry exists; no product-specific usability or accessibility testing is supplied. Public evidence is bounded extracted page text, not search snippets, and only 154 and 178 characters respectively were shared from larger pages. Atlas's research participation is incomplete; no inference should be drawn from omitted page content.
content.next_actions_and_approvals: For owner consideration only: decide whether to pursue the conditional example-first concept and authorize any separate feasibility, privacy, accessibility, or consent-based usability checks. A product/engineering review would need to establish sample license, offline clean-install behavior, runtime, data flow, and text/keyboard usability before implementation. No implementation, assignment, publication, testing authorization, or approval is implied by this synthesis.
content.authority: Proposed recommendation; no owner decision, implementation assignment or protected approval is implied.
